comments.author: @pchdavis
comments.text: Saw a document in the Alabama Archives building that said at one time West Florida residents voted to be part of Alabama and even the State of Florida government gave approval to allow West Florida to become part of Alabama. But, this was all dependent on the Alabama state legislature approving and annexing West Florida. The power in the Alabama state legislature was with the politicans in the North and they clearly understood, if West Florida merged with Alabama it would increase the number of representatives in the state governement from a newly enlarged South Alabama, so they blocked and prevented any vote being made. It was eventually shelved and forgotten. When you look at Florida politics you can see a bias and attitude toward West Florida by those from the big cities and this is why way back the State of Florida might have approved. Often you will see more University of Alabama or Auburn University stickers in West Florida than will of any of the big schools in the state.
